name: Full reference moments and bidirectional boundary evidence: three-task pilot
authorization: 2026-10-26 user requested a separate implementation route for the linked improvement and initial validation on three tasks.
source_title: 完整对比结果分析; candidate 边界查询与记忆聚合
implementation_scope: First recommended step: full class moments and bidirectional evidence. Active covariance queries, compressed memory, and ten-task expansion are conditional future work, not part of this pilot.
existing_experiment: The separate two-seed ten-task Head-RegMean/LoRM experiment keeps its original processes, protocol, clock, root and budget.
source: Reuse immutable seed0 task1/2/3 private logits and exact indices from the current-only CE Head-RegMean ten-task run. These are historical task-boundary predictions. Never load the future task10 checkpoint to generate earlier predictions.
source_training: Original frozen 5 rounds x 5 local epochs, batch16, fixed RRS A, SSB B and sample-weighted B aggregation, spherical Head-RegMean, rank32, cosine16. This route adds zero MuLoRA training steps.
reference: Same pinned initial ViT-B/16 augreg_in21k weights, never adapted; normalized CLS, same deterministic evaluation transform for train statistics and test reference features; full768 dimensions; FP32 forward, FP64 moments and optimization.
fcl_lifecycle: At each task, clients extract only their current training samples, send class n/mean/centered scatter, and immediately release feature batches. Merge includes between-client mean correction. Samples counted once, messages uniquely identified. Archive only full class statistics; no old training image or feature replay at later tasks, no future-task fitting.
objective: Class-balanced squared hinge of m-(a_c-a_j)^T mu_c-b_c+b_j+kappa sqrt((a_c-a_j)^T Sigma_c (a_c-a_j)+epsilon), with cross-task j; lambda/C sum(||a_c||^2+b_c^2), ||a_c||<=R0. All old/new directions plus old/old cross-task pairs retained.
score: For every input and every seen task, s_c=logsoftmax(z_task)_c+logsumexp(reference evidence for task). Predict over all seen classes, no true-task input. Within-task ranking must remain exactly unchanged.
arms: within-task logsoftmax with equal task support
standard full-class reference LDA with fixed0.1 covariance shrinkage/equal priors
bidirectional evidence plus MuLoRA conditional scores
remove old-distribution-to-new-class terms with original loss denominators
hyperparameters: All fixed before extraction/evaluation, no tuning: margin2log10, kappa1, lambda1e-4, R0=64, epsilon1e-12. Deterministic accelerated projected gradient/majorization with monotone restart,3000iterations maximum, unit-step gradient mapping tolerance1e-5, startzero. Finite-iteration stationarity disclosed; nonconvergence qualifies execution but blocks a clean mechanism conclusion.
baseline_policy: LDA is a standard full-class diagnostic fit using the same sufficient statistics; no parameter search or general baseline optimization. The old ridge/v1 and history_spectral experiments remain paused.
evaluation: All seen task test images per stage:1000,2000,3000. Reference test features extracted once per newly observed task, used only after that task's fitted heads have been saved. Labels are metrics-only. Preserve every arm and stage, full accuracy matrix, overall/old/new/a_tt/newmeanT2-T3/AIA/forgetting/task competition/restricted accuracy, corrected and broken predictions, evidence scales and solver convergence.
predeclared_progression_gate: Descriptive seed0 development gate, not significance: final fused overall and AIA strictly exceed fixed-centered; T3 old accuracy and mean newT2-T3 do not decrease; cross-task stolen errors decrease. Compare LDA and ablation without concealing unfavorable outcomes. Report whether fusion adds beyond reference-only and whether bidirectional terms help. No automatic query/ten-task expansion in this pilot.
qualification: Unequal-client and single-sample moment merge equals pooled stats on synthetic tests; analytic gradient matches autograd; masks and full-block rankings correct; all30class totals and at most300client-class message counts valid,15000unique current training images exactly once, no future logits/checkpoint; original raw confusion/centered metrics reproduced from saved indices; actual final evidence checkpoint reload reproduces all3000predictions for all arms; original input files not modified.

resources.clock: One independent new experiment, starts once at first actual execution; no reset or automatic costly retry; all children included
resources.historical_storage: All prior roots and data preserved; existing data/source/weights read-only shared

monitor: Merge follow-up into the existing fcl30minute heartbeat; never create a second heartbeat.
cost: Account actual reference train/test forwards, server iterations, full-statistics client upload bytes/counts, evidence broadcast bytes, original training sunk cost, solver wall time, memory and disk. Reused logits do not imply a deployable single forward: real inference requires frozen reference and adapted model forwards.
limitations: Shared CIFAR test already used in prior development; not independent held-out validation
No test selection, no hyperparameter sweep
No novelty or test-accuracy guarantee inferred from empirical moment bounds
Full-moment pilot does not validate active communication or future unseen boundary compression
delivery: Publish source/config/protocol/tests/aggregate reports after completion through the configured GitHub proxy. Keep all images, weights, full statistics, features, checkpoints and per-image logits server-private.
